TextMate bundle license

The grammars for Groovy and HTML come from the TextMate bundles
textmate/groovy.tmbundle and textmate/html.tmbundle. The README of each of
these repositories states the following license for the files in it (copied
verbatim; the README names no copyright holder):

    Permission to copy, use, modify, sell and distribute this
    software is granted. This software is provided "as is" without
    express or implied warranty, and with no claim as to its
    suitability for any purpose.

The same README makes an exception for files that carry their own license
information, or that have an accompanying "-license" file. The two grammar
files used here (Syntaxes/Groovy.tmLanguage and Syntaxes/HTML.plist) have
neither at the commits listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

(The YAML grammar from textmate/yaml.tmbundle is not under this license: it
has an accompanying Syntaxes/YAML-license.txt, which is the MIT License. See
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.)

Sources:
  https://github.com/textmate/groovy.tmbundle/blob/master/README.mdown
  https://github.com/textmate/html.tmbundle/blob/master/README.mdown
